title: Fun learning and creating in Barcelona
text: I did the workshop with Be Like Us Tours, had a great time, loved it, and got to take home the footwear I made myself.  Marianna the tour operator was wonderful in suggesting and Anne, instructor was helpful.  Recommend for group or solo!!
author: I1746RMclairew

title: Best Barcelona Bike tour
text:
I had such a lovely experience with Be Like Us Tours in Barcelona! I joined one of their bike tours and it was such a fun way to discover the city.

I was travelling with my family and children, and the tour was perfect for us. We went off the beaten paths and discovered places I would never have found on my own. I really enjoyed the way our guide Mariana mixed Barcelona’s history with its more modern, everyday side.

title: Exercise, History, Crafts and New Shoes!
text: This was perfect for our first day in Barcelona.  Our espadrille guides at Hand Made, Pelu and Stephanie were extremely welcoming and informative. Our session was met with beverages and light snacks, and we learned a lot about the history of espadrilles.  Mariana then took us on a personalized ride through El Born, Barceloneta, the Gothic Quarter: with special attention to our interests.  She shared her true love of Barcelona along with great tips.  The bikes were in excellent condition and easy to ride.  We highly recommend this activity!
author: Heather T
